title: checkpoint-recovery-consistency
summary: Assess distributed checkpoint recovery using DLRover memory agreement, persistence completion and replica transport, and NVIDIA Resiliency Extension complete-iteration selection. Distinguish worker, host and replica loss; separate queued saves, publication, application-state validity and durable recovery.
